suite: annotate armed pick (pose, isolate, filter, pre-select, bind, Esc)
expect_red: a click on a face with an interrupted like face offers the two as a group, writing nothing, still armed

mutations.contract: Like faces on the picked face's surface that do not touch it are offered as a group, and nothing is written until the offer is answered.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_feature_is_bound_once_to_a_set_of_faces (review round 2). The mutation binds the clicked face alone and never asks -- the interrupted seats of one bore would be bound one at a time as separate answers. Re-pointed 2026-11-15 (a_pattern_is_bound_as_its_like_faces_and_a_face_can_be_added): the offer's condition now also names a pattern.
